title: feat(ui): the field hand lock holds on the Gantt, the timesheet cell and the palette prefill
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu7gWK41QJR6jihChx1HnxCf)_

Part of #37448

Open surface: the in-app assistant acting for a person. Its writes run in the AI service, which does not read the hand lock, so this pull request does not cover it; card #37898 carries it. The field descriptions, the metadata-form help texts and the MCP `describe_object` guidance name it as the one surface that does not honour the lock yet. Every other surface the card lists is covered, and so is the calendar's quick-create, which the contract review (7214835610) found writing a locked field.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — no page under skills/** teaches `uiReadonly` or the hand lock (grep on main), so no skill sentence becomes false

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：手动锁（`uiReadonly` / `uiReadonlyWhen`）现在在 Gantt（拖动、调整、进度、连线、就地编辑、自动排程、撤销重做）、工时表单元格、日历快速新建和命令面板预填上都生效。
- 用户会看到：被锁的字段在这些界面上改不动，Gantt 会把条退回并提示“只读”；工时表锁定的格子变成只读，全局锁定时不再出现“添加行”；日历的标题或日期字段被锁（含服务端只读）时，点空白日期改开完整新建表单。
- 没覆盖的：应用内助手代人写入（在云端 AI 服务里，不读这个锁），描述里已写明，由 #37898 承接。
- 风险：只收紧手动编辑；API、导入、动作、流程写入不变。

## What changes

Each surface reads the one verdict of `@object-ui/core` (`fieldReadOnlyByHand`, or its static half `fieldStaticallyReadOnlyByHand` where no record exists yet) with the shell's predicate scope (`usePredicateScope`).

- **Gantt** (`@object-ui/plugin-gantt`, new `ganttHandLock.ts`).
  - `ganttPatchByHand` judges each write over the stored record inside `handleTaskUpdateDefault`, the handler every bar write reaches: drag, resize, progress handle, in-place edit, auto-schedule, conflict reschedule, and undo/redo (which skips `onBeforeTaskUpdate`, so the gate sits on the write itself). A write that changes a locked field is refused: nothing is sent, the bar is put back and a toast gives the read-only reason. A locked field the write leaves unchanged is dropped from the patch, so an in-place title edit still saves when the dates it echoes are locked. Dates compare as instants.
  - `persistDependencies` judges a drawn link over the target record's dependencies field.
  - `ganttHandLockedInteractions` narrows the authored interaction switches by the static half: a move closes when either date is locked, a resize only when both are, and the progress handle and the link tool close with their own field. An authored `false` stays `false`.
  - ObjectGantt fetches its own rows without `$select`, so the predicate operands are on the record.
- **Timesheet** (`@object-ui/plugin-timesheet`). `cellEditable` takes a `lockedByHand` judge: a cell whose record's value field is locked by hand is read-only, so it is neither edited nor cleared. A row, date or value field locked on every record closes the create (`grants.create`), which also hides **Add row**. `writeCell` refuses a locked update or delete like a `readonly` one. The timesheet fetch has no `$select`, so the operands are on the record.
- **Calendar quick-create** (`@object-ui/plugin-calendar`, `ObjectCalendar.tsx`). A create is judged by the static half (`fieldStaticallyReadOnlyByHand`), as the create dialog judges it. Where a field the dialog writes itself (the title field, the start or end field) is locked on every record, `quickCreateLockedOwnFields` sends the day click and the range drag to the host's full create form, and a locked date field is left out of that form's prefill. The static half also answers `readonly: true`, so a server-locked title or date field now hands off the same way, where `main` opened the dialog and the server dropped the value on insert. A required locked field is left out of the dialog's write (the auto-fill loop skips it), so the server applies its `defaultValue`; `requiredFieldsQuickCreateCannotFill` counts one with no `defaultValue` as unfillable, so the gesture is handed off rather than offering a write that would be refused. With no host form, nothing is offered, as before.
- **Command palette** (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `paletteCreate.ts`). The create-as prefill skips a `uiReadonly` field, as it already skipped `readonly`. A create is judged by the static half only, as the create dialog judges it.
- **List view** (`@object-ui/plugin-list`). `editedInPlace` takes the kanban lane field the board actually uses (`kanbanLaneFieldOf`: the block's `groupByField`, else the object's detected lifecycle field), so the lane field's lock operands are in `$select` even when the block names no `groupByField` (scope addition from comment 7187109328).
- **Kanban swimlane drag.** No code change: a drop on the swimlane layout passes only column ids to `onCardMove`, so the write is the lane (column) field alone, and the existing lane-field gate in `ObjectKanban.handleCardMove` holds there too. Now pinned.
- **N8 (`BEHAVIOUR_SEGMENTS`).** `uiReadonlyWhen` is not added. The key is authorable only on field definitions under `objects`, which `bucketFor` already reads as behaviour; `readonlyWhen` is in the set because inline-grid columns (a `columns` display segment) carry it, and those columns have no hand lock. A pin in `validate-field-consumers.test.ts` proves both keys already credit the fields they name; the lint source is unchanged.
- **Prose.** The `uiReadonly` / `uiReadonlyWhen` JSDoc and `.describe`, their metadata-form help texts (all eleven locales), the MCP `describe_object` guidance and its code comment, and the `handLock.ts` header now say every console surface honours the hand lock, and each names the in-app assistant acting for a person as the one that does not yet. The `uiReadonly` surface lists add "calendar drag and quick-create" (`uiReadonlyWhen` does not: a create is not judged by the conditional half). The liveness evidence (`packages/spec/liveness/field.json`) cites the new readers: `ganttHandLock.ts#ganttPatchByHand`, `ObjectTimesheet.tsx#valueLockedByHand`, and the calendar's quick-create. N7: the `cel-field-ui-readonly-when` row of the expression-conformance ledger is reworded (the edit dialog and grid cell call `resolveFieldRuleState` directly; every other surface goes through `fieldReadOnlyByHand`) and lists the Gantt and timesheet readers.

### Small decisions taken in this pull request

- Gantt: a move closes on either locked date, a resize only on both (the locked edge is refused on the write); a locked but unchanged field is pruned from the patch rather than refusing it; a refusal toasts the read-only reason; in-place edit stays open and is judged on the write.
- Timesheet: any statically locked row, date or value field closes the create (and Add row); a locked record's cell is read-only, which also blocks clearing it.
- Calendar quick-create: a locked field the dialog writes itself hands the gesture to the full form rather than closing it; a locked date field is not prefilled there; a required locked field with a default is left out of the write, one without counts as unfillable.
- Palette: static half only.
- List view: the detected lane field is always harvested.
- N8: not added, reason above.
- `Metadata-protocol: semantic` where the claim had `none`: the keys' descriptions change what an author's `uiReadonly` / `uiReadonlyWhen` does (five more surfaces lock), so the changeset is `minor` on the packages that move behaviour.

## Why

Phase 1 (#37436) routed the dialogs, record page, grid, kanban column drag and calendar drag through `fieldReadOnlyByHand`, but a person could still change a hand-locked field from the Gantt, the timesheet cell and the palette's create-as prefill. The card asks the lock to hold on every console surface.

## Tests

One pin per surface; each was ablated with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` and went red, then the file was restored (`git diff --quiet HEAD`).

| Surface | Pin | Ablation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Palette prefill | `CommandPalette.previewCreate-36286.test.tsx` | `fieldStaticallyReadOnlyByHand(field)` → `field.readonly === true` | 1 |
| List view lane operand | `ListView.lockOperandSelect-36806.test.tsx` "the lane field the board detects when the block names none" | `kanbanLaneFieldOf(...)` → the block's `groupByField` | 1 |
| Gantt write | `ObjectGantt.harness.test.tsx` "ObjectGantt.handLock-37448" | verdict forced to `write` | 2 |
| Gantt link | same describe, link test | link gate forced open | 1 |
| Gantt interactions | same describe, static test | lock defs passed as `undefined` | 1 |
| Timesheet cell | `ObjectTimesheet.test.tsx` "the field hand lock" | `lockedByHand(...)` line disabled | 2 |
| Timesheet create | same describe | `&& !createLockedByHand` removed | 2 |
| Kanban swimlane | `ObjectKanban.handLock-36806.test.tsx` "a drag on the swimlane board" | lane `fieldReadOnlyByHand` forced false | 1 |
| Calendar quick-create, own fields | `ObjectCalendar.quickCreateHandLock-37448.test.tsx` | `quickCreateLockedOwn.length === 0` made always true | 3 |
| Calendar quick-create, prefill | same file | the prefill's locked-key filter made a pass-through | 2 |
| Calendar quick-create, unfillable | same file | the locked branch of `requiredFieldsQuickCreateCannotFill` disabled | 1 |
| Calendar quick-create, auto-fill | same file | the auto-fill loop's locked-field skip disabled | 1 |

Each Gantt, timesheet, kanban and calendar describe also carries a CONTROL (an unlocked record or field still writes; on the calendar, a `uiReadonlyWhen` does not judge the create).

## Acceptance notes

- The in-app assistant is the open surface named above; it needs the hand lock judged where the assistant's writes run. Card #37898 carries it.

## Verification

Head `1916ae98` (main merged in twice; no conflict, the merges bring only `main`'s content). CI on the head: 61 success, 9 skipped, none failed.

- Affected suites: UI (plugin-gantt, plugin-timesheet, the ListView operand pin, the kanban hand-lock pin, app-shell `chrome/`, core `evaluator/`) 1650 passed, 148 skipped; UI plugin-calendar and core `evaluator/` after the rework 1105 passed, 122 skipped; `@objectstack/spec` `src/data` 6893 passed; `@objectstack/mcp` 1589 passed; `@objectstack/platform-objects` 2214 passed; `@objectstack/lint` `validate-field-consumers.test.ts` 203 passed. After the last merge the new calendar pin re-ran: 7 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated` passes on a fresh spec build (docs, liveness state counts and api-surface included); `check:liveness` passes; `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs` OK; `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` passes.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (122 commands) ran on the first head: every one passes except three that refused on a missing prerequisite (no verdict): `check:skill-examples`, `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which read `.d.ts` files this container built without (`OS_SKIP_DTS=1`). On the rework the families its paths touch were re-run, all exit 0: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` (and `--self-test`), `check-issue-citations`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:issue-citations`.
- Package type-checks were not measured locally (the workspace's dependent declarations are not emitted here); CI's `TypeScript Type Check` and `Type Check UI` are green on the head.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic (only describe and JSDoc text moved there).
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A changeset with both declaration lines, here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` generated artifacts regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
